# Clover routes

Every route clover's surface serves -- vendor-facing only. The `/__unit/*` control plane is the same for every vendor; see [Control plane](control-plane.md).

| Method | Path | Operation | Capability | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/oauth/v2/authorize` | Authorize | oauth | Authorization page. Redirects back with merchant_id, client_id and a code. |
| POST | `/oauth/v2/token` | ExchangeToken | oauth | Exchange an authorization code for the four-field token response. |
| POST | `/oauth/v2/refresh` | RefreshToken | oauth | Rotate a single-use refresh token for a new access/refresh pair. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/atomic_order/orders` | CreateAtomicOrder | orders | Create an order from an orderCart and calculate its total. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/atomic_order/checkouts` | CheckoutAtomicOrder | orders | Calculate an orderCart's total without creating anything. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders` | CreateOrder | orders | Create an order. Every field is client-owned, total included. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders` | GetOrders | orders | Orders in the elements envelope: filter, expand, limit, offset. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}` | GetOrder | orders | One order, with the requested expansions. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}` | UpdateOrder | orders | Sparse update (POST, not PUT); state moves through the order machine. |
| DELETE | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}` | DeleteOrder | orders | Soft-delete: sets deletedTime; the order then 404s and leaves the list. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}/line_items` | CreateLineItem | orders | Add one line item (price or item.id required); the order total is untouched. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}/bulk_line_items` | BulkCreateLineItems | orders | Add up to 100 line items, each with a price. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/print_event` | CreatePrintEvent | orders | Ask the merchant's default order printer to print an order; journalled, no other effect. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/orders/{orderId}/payments` | CreatePayment | payments | Record an external-tender payment; locks the order and sets paymentState. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/items` | CreateItem | inventory | Create an inventory item; name and price are required. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/items` | GetItems | inventory | Inventory items, offset-paginated in the elements envelope; expand=modifierGroups,taxRates. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/items/{itemId}` | GetItem | inventory | One inventory item by id, with the requested expansions. |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/items/{itemId}` | UpdateItem | inventory | Sparse update of an item (POST); flipping `available` is the sold-out path. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/modifier_groups/{modGroupId}/modifiers` | GetModifiers | inventory | The modifiers of one modifier group. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/modifier_groups/{modGroupId}/modifiers/{modId}` | GetModifier | inventory | One modifier, with its `available` flag. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}` | GetMerchant | merchant | The merchant record: id, name, owner and address. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/employees` | GetEmployees | merchant | Employees: id, name, nickname, role. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/tenders` | GetTenders | merchant | Tenders: id, label, labelKey, enabled, visible, opensCashDrawer, editable. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/order_types` | GetOrderTypes | merchant | Order types: id, label, labelKey, taxable, isDefault, filterCategories, isHidden, fee. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/default_service_charge` | GetDefaultServiceCharge | merchant | The merchant's default service charge: id, name, percentageDecimal, enabled. |
| GET | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/customers` | GetCustomers | customers | Customers in the elements envelope; filter=firstName=...&filter=lastName=... (ANDed) |
| POST | `/v3/merchants/{mId}/customers` | CreateCustomer | customers | Create a customer with firstName, lastName and addresses. |
| POST | `/__clover/webhooks/subscriptions` | RegisterWebhookCallback | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Clover endpoint): register a callback URL in the dashboard and start its verification. |
| GET | `/__clover/webhooks/subscriptions` | ListWebhookCallbacks | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Clover endpoint): every registered callback and whether it is verified. |
| POST | `/__clover/webhooks/verify` | VerifyWebhookCallback | webhooks | Stand-in (not a Clover endpoint): paste the verification code into the dashboard, receive the auth code. |
